title: Use of Spreadsheet in Business Applications

concepts.learning_objective: Describe what the preparation of a salary bill provides for, from payroll data to the advice to bank.
Identify earning heads such as Basic Pay, Grade Pay, Dearness Pay, DA, HRA and Transport Allowance.
Distinguish statutory deductions (PT, PF, TDS) from other deductions such as loan and advance recoveries.
Compute the number of effective days present and the Basic Pay Earned for a month.
Calculate total earnings, total deductions and net salary of an employee.

topics.title: Template design for a payroll spreadsheet

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why a spreadsheet's layout and formula cells are planned as a template before data entry.
Apply absolute cell addresses so that references to rate cells do not change when formulas are copied.
Interpret nested IF formulas that assign HRA and Transport Allowance by employee type.
Classify fixed assets as tangible or intangible and recognise the asset categories used in asset accounting.
Explain why depreciation is charged on fixed assets and compute the total depreciation over an asset's life.

topics.title: Depreciation by SLM and WDV methods using SLN and DB

concepts.learning_objective: Use the SLN function with cost to use, salvage value and life to compute straight line depreciation.
Interpret the arguments of the DB function and the formulas used for period and months in the first year.

topics.title: Schedule forming part of the balance sheet

concepts.learning_objective: Compute the closing gross block and accumulated depreciation in a fixed asset schedule.
Compute and interpret the net block as gross block less accumulated depreciation.
State the meaning of the Rate, Nper, Pv, Fv and Type arguments of the PMT function.
Write PMT formulas whose rate and number of periods match, to compute loan instalments.
